name: Boxing Kangaroo
intent: The original app-icon kangaroo illustration, with its upright boxing guard, muscular haunches, long sweeping tail, red gloves and exact Native belly inlay. Preserves the original face and proportions.
source: Original app-icon foreground illustration reused unchanged, with a separately editable Native inlay and channel accents. The source illustration was made with built-in image generation during the app-icon work.
sourceType: raster illustration + vector brand and channel layers
notes: The SVG compositions embed the PNG illustration for portability. They are not pure vector redraws. The existing app icons are unchanged.
